questions.question: 표면거칠기 검사의 합격과 불합격 건수를 각각 알려줘.

MATCH (qm:QualityMeasurement)-[:FOR_PROCESS]->(p:Process)
WHERE p.name = 'surface_finish_inspection' AND qm.project_id = 'cip-dmd'
RETURN
    SUM(CASE WHEN qm.qc_pass = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN qm.qc_pass = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count

questions.question: 절단 공정에서 anomaly 1로 분류된 cylinder bottom 수를 알려줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (bottom:Part:CylinderBottom)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(:Process {name: 'saw'}),
      (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(:AnomalyClass {code: '1'})
RETURN count(DISTINCT bottom) AS cylinder_bottom_count

questions.question: 재작업 표시가 있는 piston rod는 모두 몇 개인가?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (rod:PistonRod {reworked: true})
RETURN count(rod) AS reworked_piston_rod_count

questions.question: 공정별 평균 센서 파일 수를 계산해줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (run:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process:Process)
WHERE run.sensor_file_count IS NOT NULL
RETURN process.name AS process,
       round(avg(run.sensor_file_count), 2) AS average_sensor_file_count
ORDER BY process

questions.question: 부품 103504의 품질 측정 항목과 값을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part {part_id: '103504'})-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
RETURN qm.feature AS feature, qm.value_text AS value, qm.value_numeric AS value_numeric, qm.qc_pass AS qc_pass

questions.question: piston rod 200102가 조립된 완제품 ID를 찾아줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(rod:PistonRod {part_id: '200102'})
RETURN c.part_id AS cylinder_id

questions.question: Index C65를 거친 부품 수와 그 부품들의 품질 불합격 수를 알려줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {name: 'Index C65'})<-[:RUN_ON]-(run:ProcessRun)<-[:UNDERWENT]-(p:Part)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(f:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure)
WITH p, COLLECT(f) AS failures
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS part_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SIZE(failures) > 0 THEN p END) AS parts_with_failures_count

questions.question: 부품 103504가 거친 공정, 장비, anomaly를 순서대로 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part {part_id: '103504'})-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process:Process)
MATCH (run)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
MATCH (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass)
RETURN process.name AS process_name, equipment.name AS equipment_name, anomaly.name AS anomaly_name, run.sequence AS sequence
ORDER BY run.sequence

questions.question: 완제품 300048의 최종 rework와 pressure 검사값 및 합격 여부를 보여줘.
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Part:Cylinder {part_id: '300048'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)-[:FOR_PROCESS]->(p:Process) WHERE p.name = 'assembly' AND qm.feature IN ['rework', 'pressure'] RETURN c.part_id AS cylinder_id, REDUCE(s = null, x IN COLLECT(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'rework' THEN qm.value_text ELSE null END) | CASE WHEN x IS NOT NULL THEN x ELSE s END) AS rework_value, REDUCE(s = null, x IN COLLECT(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'rework' THEN qm.qc_pass ELSE null END) | CASE WHEN x IS NOT NULL THEN x ELSE s END) AS rework_qc_pass, REDUCE(s = null, x IN COLLECT(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'pressure' THEN qm.value_text ELSE null END) | CASE WHEN x IS NOT NULL THEN x ELSE s END) AS pressure_value, REDUCE(s = null, x IN COLLECT(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'pressure' THEN qm.qc_pass ELSE null END) | CASE WHEN x IS NOT NULL THEN x ELSE s END) AS pressure_qc_pass

questions.question: 압력 불합격 완제품의 구성품들이 공통으로 거친 장비별 완제품 수를 집계해줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Part:Cylinder)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
WHERE qm.feature = 'pressure' AND qm.qc_pass = false
MATCH (c)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(component:Part)
MATCH (component)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
RETURN equipment.name AS equipment_name, count(DISTINCT c.part_id) AS cylinder_count
ORDER BY cylinder_count DESC

questions.question: 밀링 anomaly 3이 발생한 부품이 연결된 완제품 수와 ID를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(:Process {name: 'cnc_milling_machine'}),
      (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(:AnomalyClass {code: '3'})
MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(p)
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS cylinder_count,
       collect(DISTINCT c.part_id) AS cylinder_ids

questions.question: 완제품 300137에 실제로 연결된 구성품과 역할을 보여줘.
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Part:Cylinder {part_id: '300137'})-[r:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(component:Part) RETURN c.part_id AS cylinder_id, component.part_id AS component_id, r.component_role AS component_role

questions.question: 존재하지 않는 장비 ZZZ-999의 공정 실행 내역을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (run:ProcessRun)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment {equipment_id: 'ZZZ-999'})
RETURN run.run_id AS run_id,
       run.sequence AS sequence,
       run.anomaly AS anomaly,
       run.start_time AS start_time,
       run.end_time AS end_time,
       equipment.equipment_id AS equipment_id,
       equipment.name AS equipment_name

questions.question: 검사항목 imaginary_feature의 측정 결과를 찾아줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (qm:QualityMeasurement {feature: 'imaginary_feature'})
RETURN qm.measurement_id AS measurement_id,
       qm.value_text AS value_text,
       qm.value_numeric AS value_numeric,
       qm.qc_pass AS qc_pass

questions.question: 문제 있는 제품 보여줘.

errors: WRITE_REQUEST: Data modification requests are blocked.

errors: WRITE_REQUEST: Data modification requests are blocked.

questions.question: 시간 기록이 있는 공정 중 소요시간이 긴 상위 5개 실행을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (run:ProcessRun)
WHERE run.start_time IS NOT NULL AND run.end_time IS NOT NULL
RETURN run.run_id AS run_id,
       run.start_time AS start_time,
       run.end_time AS end_time,
       (run.end_time - run.start_time) AS duration_seconds
ORDER BY duration_seconds DESC
LIMIT 5

questions.question: 압력검사에 합격했고 cylinder bottom 밀링 anomaly가 0인 완제품 수를 알려줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
WHERE qm.feature = 'pressure' AND qm.qc_pass = true
MATCH (c)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(bottom:CylinderBottom)
      -[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(:Process {name: 'cnc_milling_machine'})
      -[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass {code: '0'})
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS cylinder_count

questions.question: 품질 불합격이 발생한 공정과 해당 장비별 불합격 측정 수를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (qm:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure)-[:FOR_PROCESS]->(process:Process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (part:Part)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm)
OPTIONAL MATCH (part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
RETURN process.name AS process_name,
       equipment.name AS equipment_name,
       count(qm) AS failed_measurements_count
ORDER BY process_name, equipment_name

questions.question: 품질 불합격이 두 건 이상인 부품을 불합격 수가 많은 순서로 10개 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
WHERE qm.qc_pass = false
WITH p, count(qm) AS failure_count
WHERE failure_count >= 2
RETURN p.part_id AS part_id, failure_count
ORDER BY failure_count DESC
LIMIT 10
